message.content:
Here’s a classic ingredient list for a moist and flavorful chocolate cake:

| Ingredient | Amount |
|------------|--------|
| All‑purpose flour | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (75 g) |
| Granulated sugar | 2 cups (400 g) |
| Baking soda | 1 ½ teaspoons |
| Baking powder | 1 ½ teaspoons |
| Salt | 1 teaspoon |
| Eggs | 2 large |
| Whole milk | 1 cup (240 ml) |
| Vegetable oil | ½ cup (120 ml) |
| Vanilla extract | 2 teaspoons |
| Boiling water | 1 cup (240 ml) |

**Optional extras for extra richness:**
- ½ cup (120 ml) buttermilk or sour cream (replaces milk)
- ¼ cup (60 ml) coffee (enhances chocolate flavor)
- ½ cup (120 g) dark chocolate chips or chunks

Feel free to adjust quantities based on your preferences or dietary needs!
